base_book_source.training_features: data/features/daily_broad/*.parquet: kt.BASE_FEATURE_COLUMNS (price-volume factors, same table as the T1 book's own signal)
base_book_source.consequence: T1 book construction and coverage identical to h20260924_02's own checked coverage (daily_broad 2016-01-04..2026-09-17, momentum_252_21 first non-null 2017-01-03); the uncertainty ensemble's own walk-forward training additionally needs several years of feature/label history before its first out-of-sample prediction, so the first out-of-sample model year is expected around 2018 and is reported exactly, not assumed, in report.md.

spy_shy_bil_prices.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count (vendor ghost bars), matching run_h20260924_02_momentum_crash_guard.py::load_side_panel (imported unchanged).
spy_shy_bil_prices.coverage_required: 2016-01-04 through the latest session, for SHY/BIL cash-leg and Sharpe-convention returns.

risk_factors: momentum_252_21 has no history before 2017-01-03, matching h20260924_02's own disclosed constraint; the uncertainty ensemble's first out-of-sample year is later still (walk-forward needs several years of training history) -- reported exactly, not assumed.

LightGBM training at 500 stocks x ~2700 days x k=15 models x ~8 annual retrains is unlikely to fit in this box's 1.8G run_capped budget -- training is run on Modal by default per the brief; evaluation (applying the already-trained multiplier/exclusion series to the T1 book) is a small vectorized computation and runs locally under run_capped.sh --mem 1.8G.
fallback: If a rolling statistic (e.g. the 252-session U(t) quantile) lacks its minimum trailing window, the gate multiplier defaults to 1.0 (unguarded, matching the base book) rather than NaN or an arbitrary value, matching h20260924_02's own fallback convention; this only affects a short warmup period, disclosed and excluded from every gated window's own start date.
